html: Pick two milestones from this lesson, one before 1970 and one after 2000. Write one sentence on what the later one could do that the earlier one could not.

For each job, choose a robot structure and say why, using the spec sheets above. The jobs are: screwing small parts into a circuit board, welding a car frame, picking cookies off a fast conveyor, lifting an engine block.
Calculate how long a command takes to reach Mars at the shortest and longest delays given here. Then calculate how far a rover moving at 4 cm/s would travel in that time.

When programming an arm, you set up three frames. These are the base frame at the robot’s foot, the tool frame at the TCP, and the work object on the fixture. Targets are measured from the work object.[17]
Before you order parts, write your M0 pin map. Assign the two encoder channels, the PWM output, the two direction outputs and three buttons on an Uno. Explain why the PWM is not on pin 3.

The wiring the two programs below assume. The sensor on the control box says a part is waiting. The tool outputs command the gripper, and the tool input proves the grip before the robot moves away. Change the numbers to match your own gripper.

Optional: paste the URScript from section 07 into a Script node or file, and compare the motion with your tree program. If you have RobotStudio (within the trial, or under a school Education license), repeat the exercise with the RAPID module from section 08. Then redefine wobjFixture with the three-point method.

Categorize each of the following tasks as best suited for a Topic, a Service, or an Action. (a) Streaming 30 fps video from a depth camera. (b) Navigating a mobile robot across a room to docking station 4. (c) Setting a digital gripper output to release a part. Justify your choices.

What the turtlesim_mimic launch file starts. The two simulators share the node name sim but live in different namespaces. The remappings connect mimic's generic topics to the first turtle's pose and the second turtle's velocity command.
A mobile robot has 80 mm diameter wheels equipped with 360 PPR encoders running 4x decoding. Calculate the linear distance traveled if the microcontroller registers 4,520 encoder ticks.

Choose a method from this lesson for each image, and give your reason. One case is dark parts on a bright, evenly lit conveyor. Another is the same parts with a shadow across half the image. The final case is red caps and blue caps that are equally bright.

You have two proximity sensors, one NPN and one PNP. For each, say whether its output switches the signal line to supply common or to positive supply. State whether it needs a sinking or a sourcing PLC input.
